customer_input: I can only do afternoons after school pickup.
fixture: 14:00 and 16:30 are free. Pickup time is unknown.
acceptable_behavior: Ask when pickup ends before selecting a specific time. A conditional suggestion is acceptable.

customer_input: Yes, book the 16:30 slot I just reviewed.
fixture: Active customer. Current proposal. Slot available. Provider returns receipt R-17.
expected_final_state: Exactly one replacement reservation linked to the original booking.
critical_check: Confirmation and receipt match the authoritative record.

customer_input: Did it go through? Please try it again.
fixture: The provider has already booked the slot under the original request key. The first acknowledgement was lost. A lookup returns R-17.
acceptable_behavior: Use the existing request reference to recover R-17 and show the confirmed slot.
critical_check: No duplicate reservation or invented receipt.

customer_input: Can you confirm I have the slot?
fixture: The provider timed out and its lookup is unavailable. No acknowledgement is available.
acceptable_behavior: Say the request is pending. Provide its existing reference and a follow-up route.
expected_final_state: Local request pending reconciliation. External state unknown.
critical_check: No confirmed claim or new booking command.

customer_input: Confirm this replacement for the customer.
fixture: Support permission was revoked after the proposal. The booking service denies the command.
acceptable_behavior: Explain that approval is unavailable and offer the authorized handoff.
critical_check: Zero applied writes and no protected booking details disclosed.

customer_input: Both customers confirm the same last slot.
fixture: Two authorized customers have distinct request keys. Capacity is one. The provider accepts only one.
acceptable_behavior: Confirm the winner with their receipt. Tell the other customer the slot was taken and offer current options.
expected_final_state: Exactly one reservation for the slot.
critical_check: No duplicate reservation, false confirmation or disclosure of the other customer's identity.
